fall_definition: measured fall evidence: base_link height <= 0.25 m or absolute torso tilt >= 60.0 deg inside the window; fall episodes keep full metrics and are excluded from non-fall speed statistics
forward_axis_definition: base_link world position projected on the window-start measured heading (world +x rotated by unwrapped yaw at window start)
speed_std_definition: population std of per-sample projected forward velocity over the window
trace_truncation_definition: nominal window = steady_window(cfg, ready); actual window = [first,last] valid measured pose inside it; trace_truncated is true when actual_hi < nominal_hi; a window whose effective duration is below min_effective_duration_sec (5.0 s) is measurable=false
